steps.en: A resubmission waits for an officer to approve it

steps.why_en: The live flow stores plain Pending; the Resubmission status is never saved.
steps.why_id: Alur yang jalan menyimpan Pending biasa; status Resubmission tidak pernah disimpan.

steps.en: Officers see a Resubmission marker in OCMS
steps.id: Officer melihat penanda Resubmission di OCMS
steps.why_en: The marker shows on one notice page, not as the request status in the review list.
steps.why_id: Penanda tampil di satu halaman notice, bukan sebagai status request di list review.

steps.en: The resubmission status shows the officer's user ID
steps.id: Status resubmission tampil bersama user ID officer
steps.why_en: Only a technical system account is recorded; no officer user ID is attached.
steps.why_id: Yang tercatat hanya akun sistem teknis; tidak ada user ID officer.
